title: Agent Output Structure
description: Structure surface schema for agent output rendering. Controls what renders and which variant of content to use. Visibility toggles, variant selectors, override gates, and presentation modes across all 12 sections.

section_order.title: SectionOrderStructure
section_order.description: Controls the render order of body sections in the agent prompt.

order.title: SectionOrder
order.description: Render order of all 13 body sections. Every section must appear exactly once — any permutation is valid.

items.title: SectionOrderItem
items.description:
A body section name in the render order sequence.
Body section names for render ordering. The 13 sections that appear in the agent prompt body.

identity.title: IdentityStructure
identity.description: Structure controls for the identity section. Field ordering, declaration fusion, and visibility toggles for optional prose.

field_ordering.title: IdentityFieldOrdering
field_ordering.description:
Structural variant for identity section field sequence. Controls whether the section leads with role identity and declaration (identity_first) or with scope and responsibility (responsibility_first).
Structural variant for identity section field sequence. 'identity_first' leads with role identity and declaration. 'responsibility_first' leads with scope and responsibility.

fuse_declaration_and_role_description.title: IdentityFuseDeclarationAndRoleDescription
fuse_declaration_and_role_description.description:
Whether to merge the identity declaration and role description into a single paragraph. When false, declaration and role description render as separate blocks. When true, they fuse into one flowing paragraph.
True or false value

declaration_heuristic_postscript_visible.title: IdentityDeclarationHeuristicPostscriptVisible
declaration_heuristic_postscript_visible.description:
Whether to render the identity declaration heuristic postscript. When true, a decision-heuristic sentence follows the declaration. When false, the declaration stands alone.
True or false value

role_expertise_is_strictly_limited_posts.title: IdentityRoleExpertisePostscriptVisible
role_expertise_is_strictly_limited_posts.description:
Whether to render the expertise limitation postscript after the expertise list. When true, a reinforcement statement constraining expertise to the listed areas appears after the list. When false, the expertise list renders without a closing constraint.
True or false value

closing_identity_reminder_visible.title: IdentityClosingReminderVisible
closing_identity_reminder_visible.description:
Whether to render a closing identity reminder at the end of the identity section. When true, a reinforcement sentence restating the agent's role identity appears as the section closer. Off by default — identity is established at the top and does not need restating unless experiments show drift.
True or false value

bold_contrast_phrase_from_role_descripti.title: IdentityBoldContrastVisible
bold_contrast_phrase_from_role_descripti.description:
Whether to extract and bold a contrast phrase from the role description. When true, the renderer scans role_description for a contrastive clause (e.g., "not a debugger, not a reviewer") and renders it with bold emphasis. Off by default — most role descriptions do not contain contrast phrases.
True or false value

security_boundary.title: SecurityBoundaryStructure
security_boundary.description: Structure controls for the security boundary section. Visibility toggles, workspace path fusion, and framing variant selector.

fuse_workspace_path_and_resolver.title: SecurityBoundaryFuseWorkspacePathAndResolver
fuse_workspace_path_and_resolver.description:
Whether to merge the workspace path declaration with the path resolution instruction in a single sentence. When true, renders as one flowing statement. When false, workspace path and resolution instruction render as separate lines.
True or false value

filesystem_map_intro_visible.title: SecurityBoundaryFilesystemMapIntroVisible
filesystem_map_intro_visible.description:
Whether to render an introductory line before the filesystem display entries. Visibility may also be governed by filesystem_map_intro_visibility_threshold in display — the threshold overrides this toggle when entry count is below it.
True or false value

section_preamble_visible.title: SecurityBoundarySectionPreambleVisible
section_preamble_visible.description:
Whether to render a preamble between the section heading and the display entries. The preamble text is selected by framing_variant in content.
True or false value

section_closing_visible.title: SecurityBoundarySectionClosingVisible
section_closing_visible.description:
Whether to render a closing statement after the display entries. Off by default — the entries are self-contained and hooks enforce access regardless of prose.
True or false value

tool_names_visible.title: SecurityBoundaryToolNamesVisible
tool_names_visible.description:
Whether to show tool names alongside paths in display entries. When false, entries show paths only. Hooks enforce tool access regardless — this controls what the agent sees, not what it can do.
True or false value

framing_variant.title: SecurityBoundaryFramingVariant
framing_variant.description:
Posture for the security boundary section. Selects which content variant renders for heading, workspace_path_declaration, and section_preamble simultaneously. All three content families use the same variant key.
Posture for security boundary presentation. 'territory' frames the workspace as the agent's domain. 'environmental' frames it as the operating context. 'cage' frames it as a confinement boundary. Governs heading, workspace path declaration, and section preamble.

input.title: InputStructure
input.description: Structure controls for the input section. Visibility toggles for optional prose fragments and auto-threshold for parameter heading.

section_preamble_visible.title: InputSectionPreambleVisible
section_preamble_visible.description:
Whether to render the input section preamble. Conditional on context_required presence — renders when context documents exist.
True or false value

context_required_preamble_visible.title: InputContextRequiredPreambleVisible
context_required_preamble_visible.description:
Whether to render the context required preamble that establishes prerequisite vs reference reading mode.
True or false value

knowledge_data_transition_visible.title: InputKnowledgeDataTransitionVisible
knowledge_data_transition_visible.description:
Whether to render the cognitive transition sentence between knowledge acquisition and payload processing.
True or false value

input_completeness_postscript_visible.title: InputInputCompletenessPostscriptVisible
input_completeness_postscript_visible.description:
Whether to render the input completeness assertion. Off by default — experimental fragment testing whether explicit completeness reduces caveat-hedging.
True or false value

schema_intro_visible.title: InputSchemaIntroVisible
schema_intro_visible.description:
Whether to render the input schema introduction. Only relevant when input_schema is present in the data.
True or false value

parameters_heading_visible.title: InputParametersHeadingVisible
parameters_heading_visible.description:
Whether to render the parameters sub-block heading. 'auto' renders when parameter count exceeds the auto_threshold. 'always' forces it on. 'never' suppresses it.
Tri-state visibility control for optional prose fragments. 'auto' delegates to a threshold or data condition — the renderer decides. 'always' forces the fragment to render regardless of conditions. 'never' suppresses the fragment regardless of conditions.

parameters_heading_auto_threshold.title: InputParametersHeadingAutoThreshold
parameters_heading_auto_threshold.description:
Parameter count threshold for the auto mode of parameters_heading_visible. When parameter count exceeds this threshold and visibility is 'auto', the heading renders.
Whole number value

critical_rules.title: CriticalRulesStructure
critical_rules.description: Structure controls for the critical rules section. Visibility toggles for each rule, presentation format, and hierarchy mode.

authority_preamble_visible.title: CriticalRulesAuthorityPreambleVisible
authority_preamble_visible.description:
Whether to render the authority preamble establishing that critical rules override all other instructions. Sets the stakes before individual rules are listed.
True or false value

rule_count_awareness_prelude_visible.title: CriticalRulesRuleCountAwarenessPreludeVisible
rule_count_awareness_prelude_visible.description:
Whether to render the rule count awareness prelude. 'auto' renders when rule count exceeds the auto_threshold. 'always' forces it on. 'never' suppresses it. The prelude tells the agent how many rules to expect.
Tri-state visibility control for optional prose fragments. 'auto' delegates to a threshold or data condition — the renderer decides. 'always' forces the fragment to render regardless of conditions. 'never' suppresses the fragment regardless of conditions.

rule_count_awareness_prelude_auto_thresh.title: CriticalRulesRuleCountAwarenessPreludeAutoThreshold
rule_count_awareness_prelude_auto_thresh.description:
Rule count threshold for the auto mode of rule_count_awareness_prelude_visible. When rule count exceeds this threshold and visibility is 'auto', the prelude renders.
Whole number value

workspace_confinement_visible.title: CriticalRulesWorkspaceConfinementVisible
workspace_confinement_visible.description:
Whether to render the workspace confinement rule. Declares that nothing outside the workspace path exists. Hooks enforce this regardless — the toggle tests whether the prose helps.
True or false value

fail_fast_visible.title: CriticalRulesFailFastVisible
fail_fast_visible.description:
Whether to render the fail-fast rule. Instructs the agent to return FAILURE immediately on error rather than attempting recovery.
True or false value

input_is_your_only_source_visible.title: CriticalRulesInputIsYourOnlySourceVisible
input_is_your_only_source_visible.description:
Whether to render the input-only-source rule. Prohibits the agent from supplementing input with external sources, training data, or additional materials.
True or false value

no_invention_visible.title: CriticalRulesNoInventionVisible
no_invention_visible.description:
Whether to render the no-invention rule. Requires every claim in output to trace to input. Silence is correct when data is absent.
True or false value

output_tool_exclusivity_visible.title: CriticalRulesOutputToolExclusivityVisible
output_tool_exclusivity_visible.description:
Whether to render the output tool exclusivity rule. Declares that the named tool is the only output mechanism. Conditional on has_output_tool — data gate suppresses when no tool exists.
True or false value

batch_discipline_visible.title: CriticalRulesBatchDisciplineVisible
batch_discipline_visible.description:
Whether to render the batch discipline rule. Requires processing in batches of the specified size with immediate writes. Conditional on both has_output_tool and batch_size being present.
True or false value

discipline_over_helpfulness_visible.title: CriticalRulesDisciplineOverHelpfulnessVisible
discipline_over_helpfulness_visible.description:
Whether to render the discipline-over-helpfulness rule. Reframes discipline as the helpful behavior. Off by default — experimental rule testing whether explicit reframing reduces helpfulness drift.
True or false value

rule_presentation.title: CriticalRulesRulePresentation
rule_presentation.description:
How individual rules render. 'single_sentence' presents each rule as a dense single sentence. 'heading_plus_body' gives each rule a bold heading with an explanatory body beneath.
How critical rules render. 'single_sentence' presents each rule as a single dense sentence. 'heading_plus_body' gives each rule a bold heading with an explanatory body beneath.

internal_hierarchy.title: CriticalRulesInternalHierarchy
internal_hierarchy.description:
Internal organization of critical rules. 'flat' renders all rules in a single list. 'universal_then_output_tool' groups into universal rules (always apply) followed by output-tool-specific rules.
Internal organization of critical rules. 'flat' renders all rules in a single list with no grouping. 'universal_then_output_tool' groups rules into universal rules (always apply) followed by output-tool-specific rules (conditional on has_output_tool).

instructions.title: InstructionsStructure
instructions.description: Structure controls for the instructions section. Heading variant, mode infrastructure, preamble components, step structure, closer, and scaffolding tier.

heading_variant.title: InstructionsHeadingVariant
heading_variant.description:
Selects which heading variant renders for the instructions section. 'default' uses a plain heading. 'procedure' uses formal procedural language. 'steps_with_count' includes the total step count.
Instructions section heading style. 'default' uses a plain heading. 'procedure' uses formal procedural language. 'steps_with_count' includes the total step count in the heading.

instruction_mode_explanation_visible.title: InstructionsInstructionModeExplanationVisible
instruction_mode_explanation_visible.description:
Whether to render the exact/judgment mode explanation. 'auto' renders when instruction modes are mixed (both exact and judgment steps present). 'always' forces it on. 'never' suppresses it.
Tri-state visibility control for optional prose fragments. 'auto' delegates to a threshold or data condition — the renderer decides. 'always' forces the fragment to render regardless of conditions. 'never' suppresses the fragment regardless of conditions.

instruction_mode_marker_placement.title: InstructionsInstructionModeMarkerPlacement
instruction_mode_marker_placement.description:
Where exact/judgment mode markers appear in instruction steps. 'header_fused' embeds in the step header. 'body_prefix' places as the first line of step body. 'visual_formatting' uses visual cues to distinguish modes without explicit text.
Where exact/judgment mode markers appear in instruction steps. 'header_fused' embeds the marker in the step header text. 'body_prefix' places the marker as the first line of the step body. 'visual_formatting' uses visual cues (e.g., bold vs italic) to distinguish modes without explicit text markers.

signal_at_mode_change_visible.title: InstructionsSignalAtModeChangeVisible
signal_at_mode_change_visible.description:
Whether to render a transition signal when consecutive steps switch between exact and judgment modes. Off by default — mode markers in headers are usually sufficient.
True or false value

instructions_preamble_step_count_visible.title: InstructionsPreambleStepCountVisible
instructions_preamble_step_count_visible.description:
Whether to render the step count statement in the preamble. Tells the agent how many steps to expect.
True or false value

instructions_preamble_no_add_skip_reorde.title: InstructionsPreambleNoAddSkipReorderVisible
instructions_preamble_no_add_skip_reorde.description:
Whether to render the prohibition against adding, skipping, or reordering steps in the preamble.
True or false value

instructions_preamble_instruction_mode_p.title: InstructionsPreambleInstructionModePreviewVisible
instructions_preamble_instruction_mode_p.description:
Whether to render the exact/judgment mode preview in the preamble. Previews that some steps are exact (no interpretation) and some require judgment.
True or false value

instructions_preamble_no_extra_operation.title: InstructionsPreambleNoExtraOperationsVisible
instructions_preamble_no_extra_operation.description:
Whether to render the prohibition against supplementing steps with general knowledge or adding unspecified operations.
True or false value

step_index_tracking.title: InstructionsStepIndexTracking
step_index_tracking.description:
How step numbers render in headers. 'n_only' shows just the step number. 'n_of_m' shows step number and total.
How step numbers render in instruction headers. 'n_only' shows just the step number (Step 3). 'n_of_m' shows step number and total (Step 3 of 7).

step_done_when_suffix_visible.title: InstructionsStepDoneWhenSuffixVisible
step_done_when_suffix_visible.description:
Whether to render a completion condition suffix after each step body. Off by default — most steps are self-evident about completion.
True or false value

section_closer_guardrail_visible.title: InstructionsSectionCloserGuardrailVisible
section_closer_guardrail_visible.description:
Whether to render the section closer reinforcing that the listed steps are the complete task with no additions.
True or false value

section_closer_instruction_mode_recap_vi.title: InstructionsSectionCloserInstructionModeRecapVisible
section_closer_instruction_mode_recap_vi.description:
Whether to render a mode recap in the section closer summarizing which steps were exact and which required judgment.
True or false value

cross_step_dependency_phrases_visible.title: InstructionsCrossStepDependencyPhrasesVisible
cross_step_dependency_phrases_visible.description:
Whether to render dependency phrases indicating which earlier steps a step's output depends on. Off by default — adds noise for simple linear workflows.
True or false value

halfway_point_reminder_visible.title: InstructionsHalfwayPointReminderVisible
halfway_point_reminder_visible.description:
Whether to render a progress reminder at the midpoint of the step list. Off by default — only useful for long instruction sets where the agent may lose orientation.
True or false value

scaffolding_tier_override.title: InstructionsScaffoldingTierOverride
scaffolding_tier_override.description:
Scaffolding tier for instruction rendering. 'auto' selects from step count using activation thresholds. 'lightweight' uses minimal scaffolding. 'standard' adds preamble, markers, and closers. 'heavy' adds progress reminders, dependencies, and recaps.
Structural complexity tier for instruction rendering. 'auto' selects tier from step count using activation thresholds. 'lightweight' uses minimal scaffolding (few steps, little overhead). 'standard' adds preamble, mode markers, and closers. 'heavy' adds progress reminders, dependency phrases, and detailed recaps.

examples.title: ExamplesStructure
examples.description: Structure controls for the examples section. Preamble visibility, group heading suppression, override toggles with conditional override values, and framing sentence toggle.

section_preamble_visible.title: ExamplesSectionPreambleVisible
section_preamble_visible.description:
Whether to render the section preamble explaining how to read examples (GOOD/BAD/WHY pattern).
True or false value

suppress_lone_group_heading.title: ExamplesSuppressLoneGroupHeading
suppress_lone_group_heading.description:
Whether to suppress the group heading when only one example group exists. When true, a single-group agent skips the group heading and promotes entries directly under the section heading.
True or false value

example_display_headings_override.title: ExamplesExampleDisplayHeadingsOverride
example_display_headings_override.description:
Whether to override the per-group example_display_headings from data. When false, data passes through unchanged. When true, the sibling examples_example_display_headings value is used instead.
True or false value

examples_max_number_override.title: ExamplesMaxNumberOverride
examples_max_number_override.description:
Whether to override the per-group examples_max_number from data. When false, data passes through unchanged. When true, the sibling examples_max_number value is used instead.
True or false value

group_framing_sentence_visible.title: ExamplesGroupFramingSentenceVisible
group_framing_sentence_visible.description:
Whether to render a framing sentence between the group heading and its first entry. Off by default — group headings are usually self-explanatory.
True or false value

example_display_headings.title: ExamplesExampleDisplayHeadings
example_display_headings.description:
Override value for example entry headings. Only applies when examples_example_display_headings_override is true. Controls whether individual example entries show their headings.
True or false value

examples_max_number.title: ExamplesMaxNumber
examples_max_number.description:
Override value for maximum examples to render per group. Only applies when examples_max_number_override is true. 0 means no truncation. N > 0 caps at N entries, preserving author priority order.
Whole number value

constraints.title: ConstraintsStructure
constraints.description: Structure controls for the constraints section. Master visibility, entry limit, visibility toggles, and variant selectors conditional on their paired visibility toggle.

section_visible.title: ConstraintsSectionVisible
section_visible.description:
Whether to render the constraints section at all. When false, the entire section is suppressed regardless of other constraint settings.
True or false value

max_entries_rendered.title: ConstraintsMaxEntriesRendered
max_entries_rendered.description:
Maximum number of constraint entries to render. Zero means render all entries without limit. Positive values cap the list, useful for token budget control when constraint counts are high.
Whole number value

section_preamble_visible.title: ConstraintsSectionPreambleVisible
section_preamble_visible.description:
Whether to render the preamble text before the constraint list. The preamble establishes context for how constraints should be interpreted relative to other sections.
True or false value

constraints_are_not_steps_visible.title: ConstraintsAreNotStepsVisible
constraints_are_not_steps_visible.description:
Whether to render the clarification that constraints are not sequential steps. Prevents models from treating a constraint list as a procedure to follow in order.
True or false value

no_inferred_constraints_visible.title: ConstraintsNoInferredConstraintsVisible
no_inferred_constraints_visible.description:
Whether to render an explicit warning against inferring constraints not listed. Off by default — only needed when models tend to invent additional constraints from context.
True or false value

closing_compliance_reminder_visible.title: ConstraintsClosingComplianceReminderVisible
closing_compliance_reminder_visible.description:
Whether to render a closing reminder about constraint compliance after the constraint list. Reinforces obligation at the boundary where the model transitions to the next section.
True or false value

constraint_count_heading_visible.title: ConstraintsConstraintCountHeadingVisible
constraint_count_heading_visible.description:
Whether to render a heading that includes the constraint count. Makes the model aware of how many constraints exist, which can improve compliance tracking.
True or false value

hierarchy_tier_comparison_visible.title: ConstraintsHierarchyTierComparisonVisible
hierarchy_tier_comparison_visible.description:
Whether to render the hierarchy tier comparison prose. Cross-references critical_rules — may be confusing if that section is absent.
True or false value

hierarchy_three_tier_explanation_visible.title: ConstraintsHierarchyThreeTierExplanationVisible
hierarchy_three_tier_explanation_visible.description:
Whether to render the three-tier hierarchy explanation prose. References the critical_rules/constraints/anti_patterns hierarchy.
True or false value

section_preamble_variant.title: ConstraintsSectionPreambleVariant
section_preamble_variant.description:
Selects which preamble variant to use for the constraints section. 'standalone' frames constraints independently. 'references_instructions' and 'references_critical_rules' frame constraints relative to other sections.
Constraints section preamble posture. 'standalone' frames constraints as self-contained governance. 'references_instructions' connects them to the instruction steps. 'references_critical_rules' positions them relative to the critical rules tier.

closing_compliance_reminder_variant.title: ConstraintsClosingComplianceReminderVariant
closing_compliance_reminder_variant.description:
Selects the tone of the closing compliance reminder. 'evaluation_warning' frames compliance as tied to evaluation. 'simultaneity' emphasizes that all constraints apply simultaneously.
Constraints closing reinforcement posture. 'evaluation_warning' reminds the agent that output will be audited against each constraint. 'simultaneity' reminds the agent that all constraints apply at once.

no_inferred_constraints_variant.title: ConstraintsNoInferredConstraintsVariant
no_inferred_constraints_variant.description:
Selects how strongly the no-inferred-constraints warning is worded. 'light' is a brief reminder. 'explicit' is a template-based warning that names the constraint count.
How the constraint exhaustiveness statement renders. 'light' is a brief acknowledgment. 'explicit' states the count and forbids inferring additional constraints not listed.

anti_patterns.title: AntiPatternsStructure
anti_patterns.description: Structure controls for the anti-patterns section. Master visibility, entry limit, preamble and distinction toggles.

section_visible.title: AntiPatternsSectionVisible
section_visible.description:
Whether to render the anti-patterns section at all. When false, the entire section is suppressed regardless of other anti-pattern settings.
True or false value

max_entries_rendered.title: AntiPatternsMaxEntriesRendered
max_entries_rendered.description:
Maximum number of anti-pattern entries to render. Zero means render all entries without limit.
Whole number value

section_preamble_visible.title: AntiPatternsSectionPreambleVisible
section_preamble_visible.description:
Whether to render the preamble text before the anti-pattern list. The preamble establishes what anti-patterns are and how the model should avoid them.
True or false value

constraints_vs_anti_patterns_distinction.title: AntiPatternsConstraintsVsAntiPatternsDistinctionVisible
constraints_vs_anti_patterns_distinction.description:
Whether to render text distinguishing anti-patterns from constraints. Clarifies that anti-patterns are behaviors to avoid while constraints are rules to follow.
True or false value

success_criteria.title: SuccessCriteriaStructure
success_criteria.description: Structure controls for the success criteria section. Variant selectors for definition framing, evidence framing, and transition style. Voice, evidence handling, and multi-criteria relationship.

section_visible.title: SuccessCriteriaSectionVisible
section_visible.description:
Whether to render the success criteria section at all. When false, the entire section is suppressed regardless of other settings.
True or false value

max_entries_rendered.title: SuccessCriteriaMaxEntriesRendered
max_entries_rendered.description:
Maximum number of success criteria entries to render. Zero means render all entries without limit.
Whole number value

definition_framing_variant.title: SuccessCriteriaDefinitionFramingVariant
definition_framing_variant.description:
Selects how the success definition statement renders. 'declarative_assertion' states the definition directly. 'conditional_gate' frames it as an if-and-only-if condition. 'completion_identity' frames it as agent self-recognition.
How success criteria definitions render. 'declarative_assertion' states the criterion directly. 'conditional_gate' frames it as a necessary condition for completion. 'completion_identity' frames it as what the agent has achieved when done.

evidence_framing_variant.title: SuccessCriteriaEvidenceFramingVariant
evidence_framing_variant.description:
Selects how the evidence list introduction renders. 'properties' frames evidence as output properties. 'verification_checklist' frames as items to verify. 'quality_signals' frames as observable truth conditions.
How success criteria evidence lists render. 'properties' frames evidence as output properties. 'verification_checklist' frames evidence as items to verify before declaring completion. 'quality_signals' frames evidence as observable indicators of success.

definition_to_evidence_transition_varian.title: SuccessCriteriaDefinitionToEvidenceTransitionVariant
definition_to_evidence_transition_varian.description:
Selects the transitional phrase between definition and evidence. 'goal_then_criteria' uses a goal-oriented bridge. 'proof' uses a proof-oriented bridge. 'dual_presentation' uses a confirmation-oriented bridge.
How the transition from definition to evidence renders. 'goal_then_criteria' frames evidence as what meeting the standard means. 'proof' frames evidence as proof of the definition. 'dual_presentation' frames evidence as a confirmation check.

evidence_type_handling.title: SuccessCriteriaEvidenceTypeHandling
evidence_type_handling.description:
How evidence items render relative to their type markers. 'undifferentiated' renders all evidence items uniformly. 'graduated_language' varies language based on evidence type.
How evidence items are rendered relative to their type markers. 'graduated_language' adds per-item type markers distinguishing mechanical from judgment evidence. 'undifferentiated' renders all evidence items equally with no type distinction.

output_vs_agent_voice.title: SuccessCriteriaOutputVsAgentVoice
output_vs_agent_voice.description:
Voice paradigm for success criteria prose. 'output_centric' describes success in terms of what the output looks like. 'agent_centric' describes success in terms of what the agent did.
Voice paradigm for success criteria prose. 'output_centric' frames criteria in terms of what the output must be. 'agent_centric' frames criteria in terms of what the agent must achieve.

success_failure_independence_statement_v.title: SuccessCriteriaSuccessFailureIndependenceStatementVisible
success_failure_independence_statement_v.description:
Whether to render the statement clarifying that success and failure criteria are independent evaluations. Prevents models from treating them as inverses of each other.
True or false value

verification_guidance_suffix_visible.title: SuccessCriteriaVerificationGuidanceSuffixVisible
verification_guidance_suffix_visible.description:
Whether to render the verification guidance suffix after evidence. Off by default. When enabled, reminds the model that some criteria are mechanically verifiable while others require judgment.
True or false value

multi_criteria_relationship.title: SuccessCriteriaMultiCriteriaRelationship
multi_criteria_relationship.description:
How multiple success criteria relate to each other. 'independent_blocks' renders each criterion as a standalone block. 'numbered_dimensions' renders criteria as numbered evaluation dimensions. Only applies when criteria count exceeds one.
How multiple success criteria relate to each other. 'independent_blocks' renders each criterion as a standalone block. 'numbered_dimensions' numbers criteria as dimensions of a single quality assessment.

failure_criteria.title: FailureCriteriaStructure
failure_criteria.description: Structure controls for the failure criteria section. Master visibility, entry limit, visibility toggles, and abort stance variant conditional on preamble visibility.

section_visible.title: FailureCriteriaSectionVisible
section_visible.description:
Whether to render the failure criteria section at all. When false, the entire section is suppressed regardless of other settings.
True or false value

max_entries_rendered.title: FailureCriteriaMaxEntriesRendered
max_entries_rendered.description:
Maximum number of failure criteria entries to render. Zero means render all entries without limit.
Whole number value

abort_stance_preamble_visible.title: FailureCriteriaAbortStancePreambleVisible
abort_stance_preamble_visible.description:
Whether to render the behavioral preamble that reframes abort as the correct action when failure conditions are detected. Sets the model's stance before individual failure modes are listed.
True or false value

cite_definition_and_evidence_postscript_.title: FailureCriteriaCiteDefinitionAndEvidencePostscriptVisible
cite_definition_and_evidence_postscript_.description:
Whether to render the postscript connecting definition/evidence hierarchy to return_format reporting. Off by default — only needed when the reporting structure is complex.
True or false value

check_before_and_during_visible.title: FailureCriteriaCheckBeforeAndDuringVisible
check_before_and_during_visible.description:
Whether to render the generic temporal instruction about checking failure conditions before starting and monitoring throughout. Off by default.
True or false value

abort_stance_variant.title: FailureCriteriaAbortStanceVariant
abort_stance_variant.description:
Selects the behavioral posture for abort conditions. 'obligation' frames stopping as a duty (MUST stop). 'permission' frames stopping as the correct action (the right thing to do). Governs both preamble and definition label variants.
Failure criteria behavioral posture. 'obligation' frames stopping as a duty — the agent MUST stop when conditions are met. 'permission' frames stopping as the correct action — the agent is allowed to stop rather than forcing bad output.

output.title: OutputStructure
output.description: Structure controls for the output section. Schema embedding toggle and directory location variant selector.

schema_embed.title: OutputSchemaEmbed
schema_embed.description:
Whether to inline the output schema content directly in the prompt. When true, the full schema is embedded. When false, only a path reference is rendered.
True or false value

directory_location_variant.title: OutputDirectoryLocationVariant
directory_location_variant.description:
Selects how the output directory location is declared. 'standard' states the directory path. 'with_boundary' adds an explicit boundary constraint that all files must be within the directory.
How output directory location renders. 'standard' states the directory path plainly. 'with_boundary' adds a confinement statement restricting output to that directory and its children.

writing_output.title: WritingOutputStructure
writing_output.description: Structure controls for the writing output section. Visibility toggles for transition preamble, tool mandate, and heredoc explanation.

transition_preamble_visible.title: WritingOutputTransitionPreambleVisible
transition_preamble_visible.description:
Whether to render the transition sentence connecting from the instructions section to the output mechanics section.
True or false value

tool_mandate_visible.title: WritingOutputToolMandateVisible
tool_mandate_visible.description:
Whether to render the tool exclusivity mandate establishing that output flows through exactly one tool with no exceptions.
True or false value

heredoc_explanation_visible.title: WritingOutputHeredocExplanationVisible
heredoc_explanation_visible.description:
Whether to render the heredoc syntax explanation. Off by default. Only needed when agents mangle heredoc delimiters in their tool invocations.
True or false value

return_format.title: ReturnFormatStructure
return_format.description: Structure controls for the return format section. Visibility toggles for protocol components, metrics obligations, and cross-references.

files_vs_status_explanation_preamble_vis.title: ReturnFormatFilesVsStatusExplanationPreambleVisible
files_vs_status_explanation_preamble_vis.description:
Whether to render the explanation of the two-channel model where work products go to files and the return carries a status signal.
True or false value

token_must_be_first_word_preamble_visibl.title: ReturnFormatTokenMustBeFirstWordPreambleVisible
token_must_be_first_word_preamble_visibl.description:
Whether to render the protocol preamble establishing that the return token must appear as the first word and is parsed programmatically.
True or false value

report_all_metrics_postscript_visible.title: ReturnFormatReportAllMetricsPostscriptVisible
report_all_metrics_postscript_visible.description:
Whether to render the metrics obligation postscript reminding the agent to report all specified metrics for its return state.
True or false value

abort_vs_failure_distinction_preamble_vi.title: ReturnFormatAbortVsFailureDistinctionPreambleVisible
abort_vs_failure_distinction_preamble_vi.description:
Whether to render the semantic distinction between ABORT and FAILURE. Conditional on ABORT being a valid status token for this agent.
True or false value

honest_failure_over_dubious_success_prea.title: ReturnFormatHonestFailureOverDubiousSuccessPreambleVisible
honest_failure_over_dubious_success_prea.description:
Whether to render the failure honesty preamble granting explicit permission to return a clean FAILURE rather than a dubious SUCCESS.
True or false value

track_metrics_as_you_work_postscript_vis.title: ReturnFormatTrackMetricsAsYouWorkPostscriptVisible
track_metrics_as_you_work_postscript_vis.description:
Whether to render the retroactive orientation postscript establishing that return requirements imply tracking requirements throughout execution.
True or false value

do_not_fabricate_metrics_postscript_visi.title: ReturnFormatDoNotFabricateMetricsPostscriptVisible
do_not_fabricate_metrics_postscript_visi.description:
Whether to render the accuracy clause requiring the agent to report actual metrics from execution rather than fabricating values to match the expected format.
True or false value

failure_cross_reference_preamble_visible.title: ReturnFormatFailureCrossReferencePreambleVisible
failure_cross_reference_preamble_visible.description:
Whether to render a cross-reference to the failure_criteria section. Off by default. When enabled, connects the return protocol to the failure conditions defined elsewhere.
True or false value

enum__visibility_mode.title: VisibilityMode
enum__visibility_mode.description: Tri-state visibility control for optional prose fragments. 'auto' delegates to a threshold or data condition — the renderer decides. 'always' forces the fragment to render regardless of conditions. 'never' suppresses the fragment regardless of conditions.
